payload.goal: Find overdue customer invoice, post a reminder fee (purregebyr) of 55 NOK via journal entry (debit 1500, credit 3400), create and send a new invoice for the reminder fee to the customer, and register a partial payment of 5000 NOK on the overdue invoice.
success_checks: Overdue invoice identified in the system
Journal voucher created: Debit account 1500 (kundefordringer) 55 NOK, Credit account 3400 (purregebyr) 55 NOK
New invoice for 55 NOK reminder fee created and linked to the customer
New invoice sent to the customer
Partial payment of 5000 NOK registered on the original overdue invoice
Remaining balance on overdue invoice correctly reflects deduction of 5000 NOK
risk_notes: No specific customer name or invoice number provided — must search for overdue invoices in the system
If multiple overdue invoices exist, it is unclear which one to target — may require manual selection
VAT rate for purregebyr (reminder fee) is not specified; typically exempt (0%) in Norway — set to 0% unless otherwise instructed
Partial payment of 5000 NOK may exceed or be less than the outstanding balance — verify before posting
Account 3400 must exist in the chart of accounts; if not, it must be created first
Customer email/contact details needed to send the invoice
Sandbox is empty — customer, accounts, and invoice must all be bootstrapped if not present
payload.suggested_first_action: Search for overdue invoices via GET /invoice?invoiceStatus=OVERDUE to identify the target invoice and customer.
ordered_steps: 1. GET /invoice?invoiceStatus=OVERDUE — find the overdue invoice and identify the customer
2. Verify chart of accounts: confirm account 1500 (kundefordringer) and 3400 (purregebyr) exist via GET /ledger/account
3. If account 3400 does not exist, create it via POST /ledger/account
4. POST /ledger/voucher — create journal entry: Debit 1500 / 55 NOK, Credit 3400 / 55 NOK with reference to overdue invoice
5. POST /invoice — create new invoice for the customer with line item: purregebyr 55 NOK, VAT 0%
6. PUT /invoice/{id}/:send — send the new reminder fee invoice to the customer
7. POST /invoice/{overdueInvoiceId}/payment — register partial payment of 5000 NOK on the original overdue invoice
8. Verify remaining balance on overdue invoice via GET /invoice/{overdueInvoiceId}

planned_endpoints.summary: Find accounts corresponding with sent data.
Add new voucher. IMPORTANT: Also creates postings. Only the gross amounts will be used. Amounts should be rounded to 2 decimals.
Create a new free (aka 'user defined') accounting dimension
Create a new value for one of the free (aka 'user defined') accounting dimensions
Create invoice. Related Order and OrderLines can be created first, or included as new objects inside the Invoice.
Send invoice by ID and sendType. Optionally override email recipient.

rules: ALWAYS set BOTH amountGross AND amountGrossCurrency to the SAME value on every posting.
Do NOT include postings with row=0 — row 0 is system-generated and will cause a 422.

When using vatType != 0 (e.g. VAT 25%), include ONLY the debit posting with the GROSS amount (incl VAT). Tripletex auto-generates VAT split and credit posting. If this fails with a balance error, fall back to manual postings for all legs.
For supplier invoices, set supplier={"id": supplier_id} on the debit posting.
For salary/payroll vouchers, set employee={"id": employee_id} on each posting.
Always resolve account numbers via GET /ledger/account?number=XXXX first, then use account={"id": resolved_id}.
Postings with vatType={"id":0} (exempt) can include both debit and credit lines manually.
Pass orders=[{"id": order_id}] to link order.
Bank account 1920 MUST be configured first (see bank account setup pattern).

what_went_wrong: Check 4 failed: the reminder fee invoice (55 NOK) was likely missing required fields or wrong VAT type — vatType id:6 (0%) may not have been accepted or the invoice line setup was incorrect.
Check 5 failed: the partial payment of 5000 NOK on the overdue invoice may have used wrong query params (paymentTypeId, paidAmount) or the payment type id 37224096 was not valid for this context.
Check 6 failed: possibly the send action on the reminder invoice failed silently or the invoice was not in the correct state (APPROVED) before sending, causing the scorer to not see it as sent.
The first voucher POST failed (422) because account 1500 requires a customer reference on the posting — wasted one API call before fixing it.
what_worked: Voucher creation (debit 1500 / credit 3400 for 55 NOK) succeeded on the second attempt with customer reference added.
Overdue invoice bootstrapping and identification worked correctly (checks 1-3 passed).
what_to_try_next: For the partial payment, verify exact query parameter names: use ?paymentDate=YYYY-MM-DD&paymentTypeId=ID&paidAmount=5000 and confirm the payment type ID is correct via GET /invoice/paymentType before calling PUT /invoice/{id}/:payment.

Before sending the reminder invoice, verify it is in APPROVED status via GET /invoice/{id} and ensure the customer has a valid invoiceEmail; also check if sendType query param is needed on PUT /invoice/{id}/:send.
Fix the first voucher attempt by always including customer reference on account 1500 postings from the start, eliminating the 422 error and saving one API call.
